description: Two stacks of white paper lie on a wooden desk, with several paper clips at the top edge of the left stack and a small paper-clip box off to the right. The left hand slides in and steadies the left stack while the right hand reaches to the top edge and pinches each clip, lifting it up and away to unclip it, then both hands gather and align the loose sheets into a neat stack on the right before the right hand moves the removed clips toward the box.
